defaults.//: The build comes from the repository: "id": "latest" takes the newest egit payload scripts/build-egit.sh published (with its manifest: version, sha256, unpack, suites); pin one with "id": "egit-b522e135e4" instead. Each suite is a Tycho test module run offline from a private copy of the reactor; DTP_MAVEN_ARGS can narrow it, e.g. -Dtest=CommitActionTest. ui.test takes ~12 min for 615 SWTBot tests; give it retries: 1 if your failures are flaky rather than deterministic.
